name: bread-island
description: Supply and demand on an island where bread is the only food. Everyone earns a fixed wage and must eat; anyone who can afford a plot of the island's limited land may become a bread producer. Bread is traded in a double auction every day, land in a land market.

landsFree.description: Plots the island still has for sale. Buying one when none is left is rejected

islandLandPrice.description: Price of a free plot bought from the island

breadsPerLand.description: Bread each plot yields per tick

productionCost.description: Share of each sale that covers production cost; the rest is the producer's profit

marketPrice.description: Average price paid for bread in the last day with trades; producers and land traders use it to value land

minPrice.description: Producers never ask less than this

priceDrop.description: How much a producer lowers its price after a day with unsold bread

basePrice.description: The island's reference price for bread: what a person with no hunger offers

hungerPremium.description: Each point of hunger adds this amount to what a buyer is willing to pay

outbid.description: How far above the cheapest posted price buyers go when bread is scarce: the cap is lowestAsk x (1 + outbid x scarcity)

marginalDiscount.description: Each extra bread of the day is worth this fraction less to the buyer than the first one

maxBreadsPerDay.description: Normal daily ration: eating this many breads resets hunger to 0

ration.description: Today's ration: maxBreadsPerDay, or epidemicRation during an epidemic. Nobody eats more than this

productionFactor.description: Today's harvest multiplier: lower in a drought, higher in a golden age

droughtChance.description: Daily chance that a drought starts (when the weather is normal)

droughtImpact.description: Share of the harvest lost during a drought

goldenChance.description: Daily chance that a golden age starts (when the weather is normal)

goldenImpact.description: Extra share of harvest during a golden age

epidemicChance.description: Daily chance that an epidemic starts

epidemicRation.description: Breads needed to reset hunger during an epidemic

droughtDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current drought

goldenDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current golden age

epidemicDaysLeft.description: Days left of the current epidemic

hungerPerDay.description: Hunger added on a day without a full ration; each bread eaten removes 1

starvationDays.description: Consecutive days without any bread that kill a person

birthChance.description: Daily chance that a person with zero hunger has a child

landHorizon.description: Days of expected profit a plot is worth to an average trader

breadBids.description: Today's bread bids, one per unit, keyed <agent id>.<unit> (1 = the day's first bread): the price the buyer offers

breadBidMax.description: Most the buyer accepts to pay for that unit if the cheaper bread is gone; same keys as breadBids

breadAskQty.description: Today's bread offers: units for sale, by agent id

breadAskPrice.description: Today's bread offers: price per unit, by agent id

landBids.description: Offers to buy one plot from another producer, by agent id

landAsks.description: Offers to sell one plot, by agent id

lowestAsk.description: Cheapest price posted by a producer with bread today (0 when nobody is selling)

breadWasted.description: Bread produced today and not sold (it expires)

unmetDemand.description: Bread people wanted today and could not buy

sellRate.description: Share of today's bread that was sold

scarcity.description: Share of today's demand that went unmet

landPrice.description: Price of the last plot traded between producers

bestLandBid.description: Highest bid for land that found no seller yesterday

islander.description: A person. A consumer while owning no land, a producer while owning at least one plot.

hunger.description: 0 after a day with a full ration; otherwise grows by hungerPerDay and falls by 1 per bread eaten

spent.description: Money spent today on bread and land

stock.description: Bread produced today and not yet sold

askPrice.description: Price the producer asks per bread

riskTolerance.description: Willingness to put savings at risk

ambition.description: Drive to own and expand a business

frugality.description: How much the person prefers saving to eating well: frugal people wait longer before buying and pay less for bread beyond what keeps them alive

salePrices.description: Prices paid by the producer's last 5 customers

buy_island_land.description: Buy a free plot from the island. Driven by expected return, unmet demand, personality and one's own hunger.
buy_island_land.propensity: 0.3 * sigmoid(-4 + 25 * ctx.marketPrice * (1 - ctx.productionCost) * ctx.breadsPerLand * ctx.sellRate / ctx.islandLandPrice + 3 * ctx.scarcity + 2 * riskTolerance + 2 * ambition + 0.2 * hunger)

bid_for_land.description: When the island is full, offer to buy a plot from another producer.
bid_for_land.propensity: 0.3 * sigmoid(-4 + 25 * ctx.marketPrice * (1 - ctx.productionCost) * ctx.breadsPerLand * ctx.sellRate / ctx.landPrice + 3 * ctx.scarcity + 2 * riskTolerance + 2 * ambition + 0.2 * hunger)

sell_land.description: Offer a plot for sale: when bread does not sell, when the owner is hungry, or when buyers are bidding high.

rules.name: events
rules.description: Random droughts, golden ages and epidemics

rules.name: morning
rules.description: Wage, and producers bake today's bread

rules.name: quotes
rules.description: Publishes the cheapest price producers are asking today

rules.name: orders
rules.description: Everyone bids for bread according to hunger, savings and posted prices; producers offer their stock

rules.name: land_market
rules.description: Matches bids and offers for plots between people

rules.name: metabolism
rules.description: Hunger, starvation, the 80% daily spending, price adjustment, expiring bread and births
